fields.start: when to show the block: halfway through the silence before its first line, or 1 s before its first word when that silence is 2 s or longer (the first block: its first word)
fields.end: when to hide the block: halfway through the silence after its last line, or 1 s after its last word when that silence is 2 s or longer (the last block: its last word)
fields.last_word_end: when the block's last word finishes
fields.next_block_start: when the next block starts (the last block: its end)
